description: Source code for firmware image header manipulation, including CRC calculations and header fixing functions, based on Jonas Gorski's spw303v.c.

methods.name: crc32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over data buffer using a lookup table.

methods.name: fix_header
methods.description: Fixes the firmware header by recalculating and updating CRCs and image end address.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the program.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main program entry point, handles file I/O and calls fix_header on the first block read.
